root_cause_hypothesis: XmlTemplateGenerator.generateAxTileXml (src/tools/createD365File.ts:2901) cannot emit a valid AxTile. Three independent defects, each proven by DataContractSerializer round-trip against Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.Metadata.MetaModel.AxTile: (1) NAMESPACE: emits xmlns="Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.Metadata.V6"; the AxTile data contract is V1 (764/764 platform AxTile files use V1). Effect: the WHOLE element fails to deserialize. This one is build-visible - xppc aborted with "MetadataProvider Fatal Error: ... Expecting element AxTile from namespace ...V1 ... Encountered ...V6". (2) WRONG ELEMENT NAME: emits <TileType>Count</TileType>. The metamodel property is Type (of enum type TileType); TileType is not a property and occurs 0 times in 764 platform files. Effect (namespace fixed, isolated in variant A): Type deserializes to the default Standard, so the tile is NOT a Cue even though Query is set - the exact failure the case declares fatal. SILENT: no build error, no BP warning. (3) ELEMENT ORDER: emits Name, Label, HelpText, Type, MenuItemName, MenuItemType, Query, Size, RefreshFrequency. The DataContract order is Name first then alphabetical. Effect (namespace and Type both fixed, isolated in variant B): MenuItemName, Query and Size are all DROPPED (Size falls back to Medium) because they sort after Type. SILENT. Secondary: (4) RefreshFrequency is emitted as the number 600; TileRefreshFrequency is an enum {AsFastAsPermissible, TenMinutes, TwentyFourHours}, so the value is discarded. (5) HelpText defaults to a fabricated "@TODO:<Name>HelpText" label id that does not exist in any label file. CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS RECORD: golden_match=1 is a CAPTURE artifact, not a pass. The AxQuery and AxMenuItemDisplay goldens were produced by the grounded path and are correct. The AxTile golden could NOT be produced by any grounded route (generate_object has no tile mode; d365fo_file action=modify does not support objectType tile), so it was written via a documented d365fo_file(action=create, overwrite=true, xmlContent=...) escape hatch after the writer output was proven inert. Re-running this case against the unfixed writer MUST fail golden_match on ConDemoBlockedCustomersTile.metadata.xml. Also observed (separate, lower severity): validate_code(mode=references, codeType=xml-any) does not resolve AxMenuItemDisplay <Object> (a hallucinated target form passes) and does not check label ids in <HelpText> (the fabricated @TODO id passed clean); validate_code(mode=syntax) has no AxTile property vocabulary, so TileType/V6/numeric RefreshFrequency all passed. labels(action=info) reports @TaxTransactionInquiry:HeaderNote as not found while labels(action=search) finds it.
suggested_fix_area: src/tools/createD365File.ts :: XmlTemplateGenerator.generateAxTileXml (and the mirrored generator in generateD365Xml.ts, plus generateAxKpiXml which shares the V6-namespace/placeholder-label pattern). Extract AxTile to a shared builder like queryViewXml.ts, emit V1 namespace, rename TileType->Type, order Name-then-alphabetical, constrain RefreshFrequency/Size/Type to their metamodel enums, and drop the @TODO HelpText default. Secondary: teach validate_code(syntax) the AxTile element vocabulary and contract order so defects 2-4 are caught statically, and add AxMenuItemDisplay <Object> resolution to validate_code(references).
